integrity: All displayed homotopy types are proved from orbit-support and sphere-involution arguments; only same-model review completed, without independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The group acts on outer positions only; further fiber-automorphism quotients are outside the claim. The real-projective formula requires disjoint-edge fibers; finite enumeration corroborates, but does not prove, all-dimensional statements. Complete bibliographic uniqueness is not established.
